items.title: Brandon
items.text:
Engineer / Toolmaker / Marine veteran

Hi, I'm Brandon.

Omaha, NebraskaEnglish + Spanish

I make complicated engineering work easier to run.

Build systems that stay readable.

Choose a branch or scroll to open the index

The living index A tree whose branches open five facets: work, making, service, learning, and life. Its roots deepen as you scroll. 01 Work 02 Make 03 Serve 04 Learn 05 Life

01 / Work

Enterprise systems / 2024–now Make difficult work operable.

At Fiserv, I help turn AI-assisted delivery and application-security work across more than twenty engineering teams into one dependable operating model.

20+engineering teams about 4,000 / 200findings, before / after 2 weekscoordinated execution

In one shared two-week effort, I helped reduce a third-party-identified security backlog from about 4,000 findings to about 200. The result was not a heroic script, but a path people could review, own, and repeat.

Experience on LinkedIn ↗

02 / Make

Open source / tools that travel Build tools that outlive the moment.

I build practical, inspectable tools for people working with coding agents, designed so the workflow can outlive a model or vendor.

A Terminal JarvisRust / one interface / Cargo, npm, Homebrew ↗ B Agent HarnessGo / clean-room architecture / permission controls ↗

Predictable beats clever. A good tool should feel more like a shovel than a magic trick.

03 / Serve

United States Marine Corps / 2014–2019 Precision came before software.

As a Legal Chief and Court Reporter, confidentiality, complete records, and operational readiness were not abstractions. They were the work.

Ownership should be visible.Decisions should be traceable.Automation should be reviewable.

That root system still shapes the platforms, handoffs, and guardrails I build today.

04 / Learn

Study in public / always in progress Learn in public. Leave useful notes.

I turn experiments into notes, cheat sheets, small tools, and maintained documentation so the next person can begin further along.

NowB.S. in Multidisciplinary Studies / Computer Science concentration

May 2027Expected graduation, University of Nebraska at Omaha

In publicDocs-as-code, agent architecture, creative coding

Explore My Life as a Dev ↗

05 / Life

Omaha / home ground The work is only one branch.

I am a husband, father, and a bilingual engineer. Work, life, family, career, and hobbies all belong in the same frame, not one erasing the others.

Email LinkedIn Family / home ground
